description:
Your WordPress site appears to have been compromised. Multiple configuration settings have been tampered with and there may be unauthorized user accounts. Investigate the WordPress admin panel thoroughly and restore the site to a secure, professional state.

The site was originally named 'My WordPress Blog' with the tagline 'A WordPress blog for testing and demonstrations'. The timezone should be 'America/Los_Angeles'.

Ensure that:
- Only legitimate admin accounts exist (the only admin should be 'admin')
- The site title and tagline are restored to their original values
- Comments require moderation before appearing
- The URL structure uses clean, SEO-friendly permalinks (not plain numeric IDs)
- Public user registration is disabled, or at minimum the default role for new users is not 'administrator'

Do NOT rely on any external security plugins. Fix all issues using the WordPress built-in admin settings.
